title: Nose Landing Gear Bay Doors
summary: Sawtooth-edged stealth doors enclosing the nose landing gear wheel well flush with the lower forward fuselage.
role: Minimizes aerodynamic drag and aligns door edges with stealth planform angles when gear is retracted.
materials: Composite skin panels with sawtooth RAM-treated edges (third-party GLB mesh, APPROXIMATE).
